articles.title: King Charles says he has greater understanding of 'horrors' of slavery, falls short of apology
articles.description: King Charles III told the heads of 56 Commonwealth countries on Tuesday that he has a greater understanding of the horrors of slavery, calling it a "shameful chapter of history". This comes as Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he was open to the United Kingdom apologising for the transatlantic slave trade.

articles.title: Grève du 5 novembre : la SNCF prévoit un trafic TGV "légèrement perturbé", et "perturbé" sur la plupart des autres lignes
articles.description: Les syndicats ont appelé les salariés à un mouvement national, jeudi, afin de défendre le pouvoir d'achat.
